verdicts.reason: I picked A, but only narrowly. Its large CTA keeps the hierarchy, but the phone is clipped at the top and bottom. The badge and CTA row sits almost on the bottom edge and leaves the area to the right of the headline empty. B is more balanced as a banner, but its phone is cropped hard top and bottom. Its 'Try It' CTA has shrunk to the same size as the 'Online Only' badge, so the action no longer stands out. The badge and CTA are also stacked tightly against the right edge.
